summary.text: Backend-focused Software Engineer building Go and TypeScript systems across healthcare and logistics, with experience spanning internships and full-time engineering at Zomato and Even Healthcare. Strong in distributed systems, PostgreSQL, AWS, Kafka, Redis, and observability, with a bias toward reliable, developer-first backend tooling.

experience.title: Software Development Engineer
achievements: Owned backend for Even Infinite's Hospital Pass, simplifying member access to partner-hospital services and lifting pass engagement by 65%+.
Designed an AI calling framework for clinical follow-ups — LLM-based report summarization, care-manager suggestions, and automated call flows — cutting manual follow-up effort by ~40%.
Built a reusable onboarding package for insurance providers with automated CI/CD, cutting provider integration time from 6 weeks to 2.
Fixed recurring document re-upload failures across post-hospitalization workflows, restoring reliable generation of 300+ weekly forms for care managers.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
achievements: Built an automated vehicle onboarding flow with plate detection and dynamic step routing across a 15-screen journey, cutting manual review effort by 60% and onboarding errors by 80%.
Redesigned delayed-order ticketing with automated escalation states and operator actions, reducing cancellation-prone cases by 80%.
Built a Python sync pipeline for ~1M support tickets, automating recurring ops workflows and removing ~95% of manual sync work.
Migrated logistics map tooling to Google Maps and optimized usage patterns, lowering map-related operating costs by 25%.

positions.title: Software Development Intern
achievements: Built a production-safe Go SDK to stream multi-GB ZIP archives directly to S3, reducing transfer latency by 65% and peak memory usage by 50%.
Developed a GPS ingestion service handling ~50k location events/sec with live monitoring dashboards, improving ETA prediction accuracy by 12%.
Refactored service-to-service RPC flows with goroutine fan-out and gRPC request batching, cutting P95 latency by ~95% at ~2k TPS by collapsing chatty per-item calls into batched requests.

experience.title: Backend Developer Intern
achievements: Scaled a Strapi-based ERM platform to ~1k RPS by adding in-memory caching, optimizing SQL queries, and restructuring backend routes.

experience.title: Full-Stack Web Developer Intern
achievements: Developed backend and dashboard flows for a Next.js platform used by the UP Commercial Tax Department, with automated PDF-based discrepancy tax report generation that cut manual effort by 60%.
